summary.text: Catherine Peschke is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Sullivan 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An audiologist by training, she says she is running to oppose an income tax and to pursue property tax reform for seniors.

paragraphs.text: Catherine Peschke earned a graduate degree from Northern Illinois University in 1989 and has worked as an audiologist.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mother, tax fighter and education reformist who retired from audiology to start a family and has worked on education spending and reform for 24 years.

Peschke said her key messages include opposing an income tax, reforming property taxes for seniors by raising the income limits under RSA 72:39, and preserving recent gains in freedom such as school choice and homeschooling.
She named education reform, homeschooling freedom, school choice and tax reform as her policy interests.
